highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers the stable Skia m150 engine update with new rendering APIs.
highlights_body: It adds image and color filter helpers, improves surface wrapper performance, and corrects a CPU raster blur regression.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer and incorporates upstream m150 fixes.

bullets.lead: New culling, image-filter, and overdraw helpers
bullets.detail: Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds, crop and empty image filters, and an overdraw visualization color filter.

bullets.lead: Small-sigma CPU raster blur regression fixed
bullets.detail: Restores the expected rendering behavior for affected small blur radii.
Repeated Canvas access avoids creating unnecessary managed wrappers.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: CPU blur regression fix, SKSurface canvas wrapper caching, and v4 compatibility work

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added culling, crop, empty-filter, and overdraw APIs.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced m150 work, HarfBuzz updates, and performance improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m150 release line.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz version to 14.2.1.
